agent.finish_summary: Fixed the regression in boltons/setutils.py: IndexedSet._get_real_index had an inverted condition (`if self.dead_indices: return index` instead of `if not self.dead_indices: return index`), causing the apparent-to-real index translation to be skipped exactly when it was needed (i.e., whenever there were dead/tombstoned slots from prior removals). This caused __getitem__, pop, index(), and slicing to read wrong backing-list positions (sometimes landing on _MISSING sentinels, producing KeyError: _MISSING) after any remove/discard/pop operation. Corrected the condition to short-circuit only when dead_indices is empty. Verified via manual IndexedSet tests covering removal + indexed access, index() consistency, scalar index bounds (positive/negative IndexError), negative indexing, slicing with dead indices, pop-from-middle reindexing, and a 300-iteration randomized stress test against a reference list — all passed.
